model.name: Task 23.3: Identity merge cleans up room membership (no ghost members)
model.description: When profiles are merged (Link Account / consolidate, leaving the target tombstoned with redirectTo set), the merge MUST clean up room membership so a tombstoned profile never appears as a ghost member: a room shows exactly ONE canonical member per merged identity. Link Account MUST succeed when the secret code is correct, and the flow MUST NOT create a phantom empty profile.
model.intention: Tron: "in the heartspaces are 2 marcel donges users. i tried to link accounts but it did not work though my secret number was correct."
model.context: Room member list + identity/Link-Account merge flow. Observed in Heartspaces: two Marcel Donges (ghost member from a tombstoned profile) + Link Account silently failing with a correct secret code + a phantom empty profile (6a27140d).
